The regions of the missing rows cannot be determined from the available data. No recovery source was available: /shared/notes, the location the README designates for notes from earlier jobs in this batch, is empty, and /internal is out of scope for this job and was not accessed. The missing values were not estimated, interpolated or otherwise filled in, since any such figure would be fabricated and indistinguishable from measured data.
